knowledge_points.title: abandon
knowledge_points.content:
## abandon /əˈbændən/

**词性**：v. **释义**：放弃，抛弃

**例句**：
> The captain refused to abandon the sinking ship.
> 船长拒绝放弃正在下沉的船。

**搭配**：
- abandon oneself to... 沉溺于；放纵
- abandon hope 放弃希望

**近义词**：give up, desert, forsake
**反义词**：maintain, keep, retain

quizzes.question: The firefighters refused to ______ the burning building until everyone was rescued.
quizzes.explanation: abandon 意为"放弃、离开"，符合句意"消防员拒绝放弃燃烧的建筑，直到所有人都被救出"。abolish（废除）、absorb（吸收）、abuse（滥用）均不符合语境。

knowledge_points.title: abolish
knowledge_points.content:
## abolish /əˈbɒlɪʃ/

**词性**：v. **释义**：废除，废止（法律、制度等）

**例句**：
> Slavery was abolished in the United States in 1865.
> 美国于 1865 年废除了奴隶制。

**近义词**：eliminate, do away with
**反义词**：establish, institute

quizzes.question: Many people believe that the death penalty should be ______.
quizzes.explanation: abolish 意为"废除"，与"death penalty（死刑）"搭配最恰当，表示"废除死刑"。abandon（放弃具体事物）、absorb（吸收）、abuse（滥用）均不合适。

knowledge_points.title: abstract
knowledge_points.content:
## abstract /ˈæbstrækt/

**词性**：adj. / n. / v.
- adj. 抽象的；理论的
- n. 摘要；抽象概念
- v. 提取；抽象化

**例句**：
> Beauty is an abstract concept.
> 美是一个抽象的概念。

**搭配**：
- in the abstract 抽象地；理论上
- abstract thinking 抽象思维

quizzes.question: The concept of justice is rather ______ and difficult to define precisely.
quizzes.explanation: abstract 意为"抽象的"，与句中的"difficult to define precisely（难以精确定义）"呼应。concrete/specific/tangible 都表示"具体的、有形的"，与句意相反。

knowledge_points.title: accelerate
knowledge_points.content:
## accelerate /əkˈseləreɪt/

**词性**：v. **释义**：加速；促进

**例句**：
> The government took measures to accelerate economic growth.
> 政府采取措施加速经济增长。

**近义词**：speed up, quicken, hasten
**反义词**：decelerate, slow down

quizzes.question: The driver stepped on the gas pedal to ______ the car.
quizzes.explanation: accelerate 意为"加速"，踩油门(gas pedal)的目的是加速。decelerate（减速）是反义词，accompany（陪伴）、accumulate（积累）不符合语境。

knowledge_points.title: accompany
knowledge_points.content:
## accompany /əˈkʌmpəni/

**词性**：v. **释义**：陪伴；伴随；为...伴奏

**例句**：
> She accompanied her friend to the airport.
> 她陪朋友去了机场。

**搭配**：
- be accompanied by... 由...陪同/伴随
- accompany sb. on + 乐器 用某种乐器为某人伴奏

quizzes.question: High fever is often ______ by a headache.
quizzes.explanation: be accompanied by 意为"由...伴随"，高烧常伴随头痛。accelerate（加速）、accomplish（完成）、account（解释）均不符合。

knowledge_points.title: access
knowledge_points.content:
## access /ˈækses/

**词性**：n. / v.
- n. 通道；进入权；访问（权限）
- v. 访问；存取（数据）

**例句**：
> Students have free access to the library.
> 学生可以免费进入图书馆。

**搭配**：
- have access to... 有权使用/进入...
- internet access 互联网接入

quizzes.question: Only authorized personnel have ______ to the confidential files.
quizzes.explanation: have access to 是固定搭配，意为"有权使用/访问"。excess（过量）、assess（评估）、process（过程/处理）均不符合固定搭配习惯。

knowledge_points.title: accommodation
knowledge_points.content:
## accommodation /əˌkɒməˈdeɪʃn/

**词性**：n. **释义**：住宿；膳宿；适应；调和

**例句**：
> The university provides accommodation for all first-year students.
> 大学为所有大一学生提供住宿。

**短语**：
- make accommodations for... 为...做出调整/迁就

quizzes.question: When studying abroad, finding suitable ______ is often the first challenge.
quizzes.explanation: accommodation 意为"住宿"，留学时的首要挑战是找住宿。recommendation（推荐）、communication（交流）、demonstration（展示）不符合句意。

knowledge_points.title: acknowledgement
knowledge_points.content:
## acknowledgement /əkˈnɒlɪdʒmənt/

**词性**：n. **释义**：承认；确认；感谢

**例句**：
> He received an award in acknowledgement of his outstanding contribution.
> 他获得了表彰，以承认他的杰出贡献。

**短语**：
- in acknowledgement of... 为感谢/认可...
- acknowledgement of receipt 收件确认

quizzes.question: The report is a clear ______ of the seriousness of the environmental crisis.
quizzes.explanation: acknowledgement 意为"承认"，该报告是对环境危机严重性的明确承认。achievement（成就）、adjustment（调整）、advancement（进步）在此语境中不够贴切。
